name: 进程管家
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="8" rx="2"/><rect x="2" y="14" width="20" height="8" rx="2"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="6.01" y2="6"/><line x1="6" y1="18" x2="6.01" y2="18"/></svg>
description: 用 pm2 统一托管 AI 启动的后台任务：长期服务与调试实例交给 pm2 后有名字、有状态、有日志，可单独停止/重启/删除；宿主顶栏「后台任务」面板与插件面板看的是同一份列表（状态/CPU/内存/重启次数/时长/日志），未装 pm2 时一键安装。插件不拦截 AI 的任何命令，只提供工具与面板，管不管由模型和用户自行决定。
descriptionEn: Supervise AI-started background tasks with pm2: long-running services and debug instances get a name, a status, logs, and per-app stop/restart/delete; the host background-tasks panel and the plugin panel show one shared list (status/CPU/memory/restarts/uptime/logs), and pm2 installs in one click when missing. The plugin never intercepts AI commands — it only offers the tool and the panel; whether a process goes through pm2 is up to the model and the user.

settings.label: pm2 入口路径（可选）
settings.hint: 留空自动探测（node 前缀 → npm root -g → 环境变量 PI_WEB_PM2）。填绝对路径时指向 pm2 的 bin/pm2（JS 入口，不是 .cmd 垫片）。
